blocks.zh:
Section IV.B+C: Drug CGMP Provisions & Biologics
藥品CGMP規定與生物製劑（器材QS基礎簡化途徑附加要求）
blocks.en:
Section IV.B+C: Drug CGMP Provisions & Biologics
Drug CGMP provisions and biological products (additional requirements under the device QS-based streamlined approach)

blocks.zh: Learning Objectives 學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: Identify the 8 drug CGMP provisions that must be added when using the device QS-based streamlined approach — 識別採用器材QS簡化途徑時必須附加的8項藥品CGMP規定
blocks.en: Identify the 8 drug CGMP provisions that must be added when using the device QS-based streamlined approach

blocks.zh: Explain why device manufacturers face specific gaps in component testing, yield calculation, and reserve samples — 說明器材製造商在組件測試、產量計算與留樣方面的常見落差
blocks.en: Explain why device manufacturers face specific gaps in component testing, yield calculation, and reserve samples

blocks.zh: Apply 21 CFR 211.84 incoming testing requirements to drug components and container closure systems — 將211.84進廠測試要求應用於藥品組件與容器密封系統
blocks.en: Apply 21 CFR 211.84 incoming testing requirements to drug components and container closure systems

blocks.zh: Calculate theoretical and actual yield for drug constituent parts at each manufacturing phase — 針對各製造階段計算藥品組成部分的理論與實際產量
blocks.en: Calculate theoretical and actual yield for drug constituent parts at each manufacturing phase

blocks.zh: Distinguish when OTC tamper-evident packaging requirements apply to combination products — 區分OTC防篡改包裝要求何時適用於組合產品
blocks.en: Distinguish when OTC tamper-evident packaging requirements apply to combination products

blocks.zh: Establish expiration dating and stability programs specific to drug constituent parts in combination products — 針對組合產品中的藥品組成部分建立效期標示與穩定性計畫
blocks.en: Establish expiration dating and stability programs specific to drug constituent parts in combination products

blocks.zh: Apply special testing requirements (sterility, pyrogen, dissolution) to relevant combination product types — 將特殊測試要求（滅菌、熱原、溶出）應用於相關組合產品類型
blocks.en: Apply special testing requirements (sterility, pyrogen, dissolution) to relevant combination product types

blocks.zh: Understand additional CGMP obligations when a combination product includes a biological product or HCT/P — 瞭解組合產品包含生物製劑或HCT/P時的額外CGMP義務
blocks.en: Understand additional CGMP obligations when a combination product includes a biological product or HCT/P

blocks.zh: Context: The Device QS-Based Streamlined Approach / 背景：器材QS基礎簡化途徑
blocks.en: Context: The Device QS-Based Streamlined Approach

blocks.zh: 解說：什麼是「器材QS簡化途徑」？
blocks.en: Commentary: What is the "device QS-based streamlined approach"?

blocks.zh: 核心概念：兩種簡化途徑
blocks.en: Core concept: two streamlined approaches

blocks.zh: 21 CFR Part 4 為組合產品提供兩種簡化途徑：
blocks.en: 21 CFR Part 4 provides two streamlined approaches for combination products:

blocks.zh: 藥品CGMP基礎（4.4(b)(1)）：主要以21 CFR 210/211為框架，附加特定器材QS要求
blocks.en: Drug CGMP-based (4.4(b)(1)): uses 21 CFR 210/211 as the primary framework, with specific device QS requirements added

blocks.zh: 器材QS基礎（4.4(b)(2)）：主要以21 CFR Part 820為框架，附加8項特定藥品CGMP要求
blocks.en: Device QS-based (4.4(b)(2)): uses 21 CFR Part 820 as the primary framework, with 8 specific drug CGMP requirements added

blocks.zh: 本節（IV.B）專門解說第二種途徑：以器材QS為主體，附加8項藥品CGMP規定。
blocks.en: This section (IV.B) covers the second approach: device QS as the main framework, with 8 drug CGMP provisions added.

blocks.zh: 比喻：「基礎套餐 + 必選加點」
blocks.en: Analogy: "a set menu plus mandatory add-ons"

blocks.zh: 想像器材QS（21 CFR 820）是一套完整的品質餐廳套餐。使用這條路徑的廠商必須再「加點」8道菜——這8道菜都是純藥品製造獨有的要求，器材QS本身沒有。
blocks.en: Think of the device QS (21 CFR 820) as a complete quality set menu at a restaurant. A manufacturer taking this path must "order" 8 additional dishes. All 8 are requirements unique to drug manufacturing that the device QS does not contain.

blocks.zh: CDMO場景：何時選擇器材QS途徑？
blocks.en: CDMO scenario: when to choose the device QS approach?

blocks.zh: 這條路徑較常見於：器材公司（如藥物塗層支架、預填充注射器製造商）新增藥品組成部分，已有完善的21 CFR 820體系，不想重建整套藥品GMP，因此選擇以820為主體，僅補齊8項藥品特有要求。
blocks.en: This path is more common for device companies (for example, makers of drug-coated stents or prefilled syringes) adding a drug constituent part. They already have a well-established 21 CFR 820 system and do not want to rebuild a full drug GMP system, so they keep 820 as the main framework and fill in only the 8 drug-specific requirements.

blocks.zh: 對於傳統無菌藥品CDMO而言，更常見的是反過來——以211為主體（IV.A途徑）。但隨著CDMO承接更多藥械組合產品，理解這8項要求變得日益重要。
blocks.en: For a traditional sterile drug CDMO, the opposite is more common: 211 as the main framework (the IV.A approach). But as CDMOs take on more drug-device combination products, understanding these 8 requirements is becoming increasingly important.

blocks.zh: 批次定義的重要性
blocks.en: Why the batch definition matters

blocks.zh: 無論選哪條途徑，批次（Batch/Lot）的定義在組合產品中特別複雜——藥品組成部分、器材組成部分、最終組合產品各自可能有不同的批次編號。必須建立清晰的追溯程序，確保從原料到成品的批次連結。
blocks.en: Whichever approach is chosen, the definition of a batch/lot is particularly complex for combination products: the drug constituent part, the device constituent part, and the final combination product may each carry a different batch number. A clear traceability procedure must be established so that batches are linked from raw material to finished product.

blocks.zh: IV.B.1 — 21 CFR 211.84: Component Testing and Approval/Rejection / 組件測試與核准/拒絕
blocks.en: IV.B.1 - 21 CFR 211.84: Component Testing and Approval/Rejection

blocks.zh: 解說：211.84 — 器材廠的關鍵補強點
blocks.en: Commentary: 211.84 - a key reinforcement point for device manufacturers
What does 211.84 require?

blocks.zh: 身份確認（Identity Testing）：每批藥品組件都必須進行身份測試，不得完全依賴供應商COA
blocks.en: Identity testing: every lot of drug components must undergo identity testing; reliance on the supplier COA alone is not acceptable

blocks.zh: 代表性取樣：取樣計畫必須有統計依據（樣本數、信心水準）
blocks.en: Representative sampling: the sampling plan must be statistically justified (sample size, confidence level)

blocks.zh: 放行前隔離：每批物料在QCU放行前必須隔離，不得投入生產
blocks.en: Quarantine before release: each lot of material must be quarantined until released by the QCU and must not be used in production

blocks.zh: 容器密封系統：初級包裝（安瓿、瓶、塞、蓋）都納入管控
blocks.en: Container closure systems: primary packaging (ampoules, vials, stoppers, caps) is brought under control

blocks.zh: 器材廠的典型落差
blocks.en: Typical gaps at device manufacturers

blocks.zh: 21 CFR 820.80（接收驗收）只要求廠商確保收到的產品符合規格——但沒有規定必須進行身份測試，也沒有COA可靠性驗證要求。
blocks.en: 21 CFR 820.80 (receiving acceptance) only requires the manufacturer to ensure that incoming product conforms to specifications. It does not require identity testing, nor verification of COA reliability.

blocks.zh: 器材廠通常依賴供應商COA或功能性檢測，缺乏藥品規格的鑑別測試（identity test）。這是最常見的合規缺口之一。
blocks.en: Device manufacturers typically rely on supplier COAs or functional testing and lack identity tests against drug specifications. This is one of the most common compliance gaps.

blocks.zh: 比喻：器材廠收料 vs. 藥廠收料
blocks.en: Analogy: receiving materials at a device plant vs. a drug plant

blocks.zh: 器材廠做法：收到鋼製螺絲 → 目視檢查 + 尺寸量測 → OK，放行。
blocks.en: Device plant practice: receives steel screws, performs visual inspection and dimensional measurement, and releases them if OK.

blocks.zh: 藥廠211.84做法：收到API → 身份鑑別測試（HPLC、IR）+ COA審查 + 樣本符合統計抽樣計畫 → QCU正式放行。
blocks.en: Drug plant practice under 211.84: receives API, performs identity testing (HPLC, IR), reviews the COA, draws samples under a statistical sampling plan, and the QCU formally releases the lot.

blocks.zh: 器材廠導入藥品組成部分後，必須把前者升級到後者的嚴謹度。
blocks.en: Once a device manufacturer introduces a drug constituent part, it must raise the first practice to the rigor of the second.

blocks.zh: CDMO實務：容器密封系統的雙重身份
blocks.en: CDMO practice: the dual identity of the container closure system

blocks.zh: 對於預填充注射器，注射器筒體既是器材（器材組成部分）也是藥品的容器密封系統（藥品主要包裝）。此時211.84的要求就適用於注射器筒體，包括：矽化量測、提取物測試、相容性研究等，遠超一般器材的入廠驗收範疇。
blocks.en: For a prefilled syringe, the syringe barrel is both a device (device constituent part) and the drug container closure system (primary drug packaging). The 211.84 requirements therefore apply to the syringe barrel, including siliconization measurement, extractables testing, and compatibility studies, going far beyond normal incoming acceptance of a device.

blocks.zh: 211.84 合規路徑比較
blocks.en: Comparison of 211.84 compliance paths

blocks.zh:
路徑A：完整自測
自行進行所有鑑別、純度、強度測試 → 符合211.84(d)
blocks.en:
Path A: full in-house testing
Perform all identity, purity, and strength testing in-house, complying with 211.84(d)

blocks.zh:
路徑B：COA依賴（有條件）
接受供應商COA + 自行進行身份鑑別測試 + 定期驗證COA可靠性 → 符合211.84(d)(3)
blocks.en:
Path B: reliance on COA (conditional)
Accept the supplier COA, perform your own identity testing, and periodically validate COA reliability, complying with 211.84(d)(3)

blocks.zh: 注意：路徑B仍必須做身份測試，不可完全略過。
blocks.en: Note: Path B still requires identity testing; it cannot be skipped entirely.

blocks.zh: 思考練習
blocks.en: Exercise

blocks.zh: 一家藥物塗層球囊（Drug-Coated Balloon）廠商，以器材QS簡化途徑運作。請判斷以下哪些物料需要符合211.84：
blocks.en: A drug-coated balloon manufacturer operates under the device QS streamlined approach. Decide which of the following materials must meet 211.84:

blocks.zh: 紫杉醇（藥品組成部分的活性成分）
blocks.en: Paclitaxel (the active ingredient of the drug constituent part)

blocks.zh: 球囊導管材料（PEBAX，僅用於器材組成部分）
blocks.en: Balloon catheter material (PEBAX, used only in the device constituent part)

blocks.zh: 最終產品的滅菌袋（保護性外包裝）
blocks.en: The sterilization pouch of the final product (protective outer packaging)

blocks.zh: 包含藥品的球囊本身（器材也是藥品容器）
blocks.en: The balloon itself, which contains the drug (the device is also the drug container)

blocks.zh: 答案：1和4必須符合211.84；2不需要；3視乎是否提供藥品的額外保護。
blocks.en: Answer: 1 and 4 must meet 211.84; 2 does not; 3 depends on whether it provides additional protection to the drug.

blocks.zh: IV.B.2 — 21 CFR 211.103: Calculation of Yield / 產量計算
blocks.en: IV.B.2 - 21 CFR 211.103: Calculation of Yield

blocks.zh: 解說：211.103 — 器材廠的全新概念
blocks.en: Commentary: 211.103 - a brand-new concept for device manufacturers

blocks.zh: 什麼是「理論產量」vs.「實際產量」？
blocks.en: What are "theoretical yield" and "actual yield"?

blocks.zh: 理論產量（Theoretical Yield）：若製造過程完全沒有損失，預期可以生產多少單位（以藥品投入量計算）。
blocks.en: Theoretical yield: the number of units expected if there were no losses at all in the manufacturing process (calculated from the drug input).

blocks.zh: 實際產量（Actual Yield）：實際得到的合格單位數量（或重量）。
blocks.en: Actual yield: the number (or weight) of acceptable units actually obtained.

blocks.zh: 產量百分比 = 實際產量 / 理論產量 × 100%
blocks.en: Percentage yield = actual yield / theoretical yield × 100%

blocks.zh: 每個製造階段都必須計算，且必須有預設的可接受範圍（上下限）。超出範圍即啟動調查。
blocks.en: Yield must be calculated at each manufacturing phase, with predetermined acceptable limits (upper and lower). A result outside the limits triggers an investigation.

blocks.zh: 比喻：做麵包 vs. 做注射器
blocks.en: Analogy: baking bread vs. making syringes

blocks.zh: 藥廠觀點：100 kg API → 理論上可製作 10,000 支注射劑 → 實際製出 9,850 支 → 產量98.5% → 記錄、確認在可接受範圍內（假設95-102%）。
blocks.en: Drug plant view: 100 kg API can theoretically make 10,000 injection units, and 9,850 are actually produced, so the yield is 98.5%. It is recorded and confirmed to be within the acceptable range (assume 95-102%).

blocks.zh: 器材廠傳統觀點：製作10,000個導管 → 9,850個通過測試 → 記錄良率（yield rate），但沒有「理論產量」概念，也沒有強制調查觸發點。
blocks.en: Traditional device plant view: make 10,000 catheters, 9,850 pass testing, and the yield rate is recorded. But there is no concept of "theoretical yield" and no mandatory investigation trigger.

blocks.zh: 這兩種觀點都關心損失，但藥品GMP的產量計算有更嚴格的文件與調查要求。
blocks.en: Both views care about losses, but drug GMP yield calculation has stricter documentation and investigation requirements.

blocks.zh: 重要：為什麼產量可以發現問題？
blocks.en: Important: why can yield reveal problems?

blocks.zh: 產量偏低可能意味著：設備故障（填充量不足）、原料密度異常、操作失誤、未記錄的廢棄物。這些問題在樣本放行測試中可能完全看不出來（因為測試的是好的產品），但產量計算可以捕捉到整體批次的異常。
blocks.en: Low yield may point to equipment malfunction (underfilling), abnormal raw material density, operator error, or unrecorded waste. These problems may be completely invisible in sample release testing (because the product tested is good product), but yield calculation can catch abnormalities in the batch as a whole.

blocks.zh: CDMO實務：預填充注射器產量計算
blocks.en: CDMO practice: yield calculation for prefilled syringes

blocks.zh: 製造預填充注射器（PFS）時，產量計算的關鍵節點包括：
blocks.en: When manufacturing prefilled syringes (PFS), the key yield calculation points include:

blocks.zh: 配液階段：投入API量 → 配製藥液量（% 理論值）
blocks.en: Compounding stage: API input vs. volume of drug solution prepared (% of theoretical)

blocks.zh: 過濾階段：藥液過濾後回收率（過濾器保留量需記錄）
blocks.en: Filtration stage: recovery of drug solution after filtration (filter retention must be recorded)

blocks.zh: 灌裝階段：填充藥液總量 vs. 灌裝後實際產品數 × 標示量
blocks.en: Filling stage: total drug solution filled vs. actual number of products after filling × labeled amount

blocks.zh: 組裝/包裝階段：成品通過率
blocks.en: Assembly/packaging stage: pass rate of finished product

blocks.zh: 每個節點都需有預定的可接受範圍，超出需調查。
blocks.en: Each point needs a predetermined acceptable range, and any result outside it must be investigated.

blocks.zh: 文件整合建議：DHR中的產量計算
blocks.en: Documentation integration recommendation: yield calculations in the DHR

blocks.zh: 器材廠已有DHR（Device History Record，21 CFR 820.184）。FDA建議將藥品的產量計算記錄整合到DHR中，不需要建立全新的文件體系——但DHR必須擴展以容納：
blocks.en: Device manufacturers already have a DHR (Device History Record, 21 CFR 820.184). FDA recommends integrating drug yield calculation records into the DHR rather than building an entirely new documentation system, but the DHR must be extended to include:

blocks.zh: 各製造階段的理論產量計算公式
blocks.en: Theoretical yield calculation formulas for each manufacturing phase

blocks.zh: 實際產量記錄（雙人複核簽名）
blocks.en: Actual yield records (with second-person verification signature)

blocks.zh: 可接受範圍的預定標準
blocks.en: Predetermined criteria for the acceptable range

blocks.zh: 超出範圍的調查記錄連結
blocks.en: Links to investigation records for out-of-range results

blocks.zh: IV.B.3 — 21 CFR 211.132: Tamper-Evident Packaging (OTC Only) / 防篡改包裝（僅限OTC）
blocks.en: IV.B.3 - 21 CFR 211.132: Tamper-Evident Packaging (OTC Only)

blocks.zh: 解說：211.132 — 只適用OTC的規定
blocks.en: Commentary: 211.132 - applies to OTC products only

blocks.zh: 關鍵：處方產品不適用！
blocks.en: Key point: prescription products are not covered!

blocks.zh: 211.132的防篡改包裝要求只適用於OTC（非處方）組合產品。絕大多數無菌注射型組合產品（預填充注射器、藥物塗層支架）都是處方產品（Rx），不受此條款約束。
blocks.en: The tamper-evident packaging requirement of 211.132 applies only to OTC (over-the-counter) combination products. The great majority of sterile injectable combination products (prefilled syringes, drug-coated stents) are prescription (Rx) products and are not subject to this provision.

blocks.zh: 這是8項附加要求中條件限制最明確的一項——許多器材廠可能完全不適用。
blocks.en: Of the 8 additional requirements, this is the one with the clearest conditional limitation, and many device manufacturers may find it does not apply at all.

blocks.zh: OTC組合產品：典型例子
blocks.en: OTC combination products: typical examples

blocks.zh: 牙膏 + 牙刷（共同包裝）— 可能有豁免
blocks.en: Toothpaste + toothbrush (co-packaged): an exemption may apply

blocks.zh: OTC鼻噴劑 + 沖洗瓶
blocks.en: OTC nasal spray + rinse bottle

blocks.zh: OTC局部藥膏 + 敷料
blocks.en: OTC topical ointment + dressing

blocks.zh: 戒煙貼片（單一實體組合產品）
blocks.en: Smoking cessation patch (single-entity combination product)

blocks.zh: 需要確認產品的OTC狀態，以及是否符合任何豁免條件。
blocks.en: Confirm the OTC status of the product and whether any exemption conditions are met.

blocks.zh: 211.132 合規要求概覽
blocks.en: Overview of 211.132 compliance requirements

blocks.zh: 必要措施：
blocks.en: Required measures:

blocks.zh: 採用防篡改包裝機制（如封膜、縮套、安全貼）
blocks.en: Adopt a tamper-evident packaging mechanism (such as a sealed film, shrink band, or security label)

blocks.zh: 外包裝標籤必須標示防篡改特徵說明
blocks.en: The outer package label must include a statement describing the tamper-evident feature

blocks.zh: 若更改已核准OTC產品的包裝，須在配送前通知主責中心
blocks.en: If the packaging of an approved OTC product is changed, the lead center must be notified before distribution

blocks.zh: 可能的豁免（須向FDA申請）：
blocks.en: Possible exemptions (must be requested from FDA):

blocks.zh: 特定形式（如氣霧劑）— 可豁免標示說明
blocks.en: Specific dosage forms (such as aerosols): may be exempt from the labeling statement

blocks.zh: 特定產品類別 — 可申請豁免包裝要求
blocks.en: Specific product categories: an exemption from the packaging requirement may be requested

blocks.zh: 比喻：安全封條的邏輯
blocks.en: Analogy: the logic of the safety seal

blocks.zh: OTC產品在開架零售，任何人都能拿起來翻看，潛在惡意篡改的機會更高。防篡改包裝的目的是讓消費者能確認「這個產品從出廠到現在沒有被打開過」。處方藥通常由藥師控管，配送鏈受到更多管控，因此這項要求的迫切性不同。
blocks.en: OTC products are sold on open shelves where anyone can pick them up and examine them, so the opportunity for malicious tampering is higher. The purpose of tamper-evident packaging is to let consumers confirm that "this product has not been opened since it left the factory." Prescription drugs are normally controlled by pharmacists and the distribution chain is more tightly controlled, so the urgency of this requirement is different.

blocks.zh: IV.B.4 — 21 CFR 211.137: Expiration Dating / 效期標示
blocks.en: IV.B.4 - 21 CFR 211.137: Expiration Dating

blocks.zh: 解說：211.137 — 器材廠的核心轉變
blocks.en: Commentary: 211.137 - a core shift for device manufacturers

blocks.zh: 器材QS vs. 藥品GMP：效期要求的差距
blocks.en: Device QS vs. drug GMP: the gap in expiration dating requirements

blocks.zh: 21 CFR Part 820（器材QS）並沒有等同於211.137的效期標示要求。器材可以有「使用壽命（Shelf Life）」的設計驗證，但這與藥品的效期標示（必須基於穩定性數據、標示在標籤上）是不同概念。
blocks.en: 21 CFR Part 820 (device QS) has no equivalent of the 211.137 expiration dating requirement. Devices may have design validation of a "shelf life", but this is a different concept from drug expiration dating, which must be based on stability data and shown on the label.

blocks.zh: 引入藥品組成部分後，效期標示變成強制義務，且必須有穩定性數據支持。
blocks.en: Once a drug constituent part is introduced, expiration dating becomes a mandatory obligation and must be supported by stability data.

blocks.zh: 「最短效期」原則
blocks.en: The "shortest expiry" principle

blocks.zh: 組合產品如果標示單一效期，必須採用任何組成部分中最短的效期。這意味著：
blocks.en: If a combination product carries a single expiration date, it must use the shortest expiration date of any constituent part. This means:

blocks.zh: 器材組成部分效期：5年
blocks.en: Device constituent part expiry: 5 years

blocks.zh: 藥品組成部分效期：2年（基於穩定性數據）
blocks.en: Drug constituent part expiry: 2 years (based on stability data)

blocks.zh: 組合產品效期：2年（取最短）
blocks.en: Combination product expiry: 2 years (the shortest)

blocks.zh: 這可能對商業策略有重大影響——藥品穩定性往往成為組合產品商業壽命的決定因素。
blocks.en: This can have a major impact on commercial strategy, since drug stability often determines the commercial shelf life of a combination product.

blocks.zh: CDMO實務：藥物塗層支架的效期挑戰
blocks.en: CDMO practice: the expiry challenge of drug-eluting stents

blocks.zh: 藥物塗層支架（Drug-Eluting Stent）的效期涉及：
blocks.en: The expiry of a drug-eluting stent involves:

blocks.zh: 藥品穩定性：藥物（如依維莫司）在支架塗層上的降解速率
blocks.en: Drug stability: degradation rate of the drug (such as everolimus) in the stent coating

blocks.zh: 器材力學性能：支架金屬骨架的耐久性（通常更長）
blocks.en: Device mechanical performance: durability of the metal stent frame (usually longer)

blocks.zh: 包裝完整性：滅菌屏障維持時間
blocks.en: Packaging integrity: how long the sterile barrier is maintained

blocks.zh: 組合互動：器材-藥品界面的相容性隨時間變化
blocks.en: Combination interaction: changes over time in compatibility at the device-drug interface

blocks.zh: 最終效期由最短的因素決定，必須有穩定性研究支持。
blocks.en: The final expiry is determined by the shortest of these factors and must be supported by stability studies.

blocks.zh: 比喻：組合便當的保存期限
blocks.en: Analogy: the shelf life of a combination lunch box

blocks.zh: 一個包含「飯糰（藥品，1天）」和「保鮮袋（器材，1年）」的組合包裝，整體保存期限是1天——受最短壽命的組件決定。就算袋子可以用1年，便當不能賣超過1天。
blocks.en: In a combination pack containing a "rice ball (drug, 1 day)" and a "zip bag (device, 1 year)", the overall shelf life is 1 day, determined by the component with the shortest life. Even if the bag lasts 1 year, the lunch box cannot be sold beyond 1 day.

blocks.zh: 一個co-packaged組合產品包含：(A) 藥物玻璃瓶（效期24個月）和 (B) 一次性給藥器械。若兩者可以獨立使用，效期應如何標示？若兩者不能獨立使用，效期又應如何決定？
blocks.en: A co-packaged combination product contains (A) a glass drug vial (expiry 24 months) and (B) a single-use drug delivery device. If the two can be used independently, how should the expiry be labeled? If they cannot be used independently, how should the expiry be determined?

blocks.zh: 答案：若可獨立使用，分別標示各自效期；若不可獨立使用（single-entity），以最短效期為準（24個月），同時需考慮組合後的交互作用。
blocks.en: Answer: If they can be used independently, label each with its own expiry. If they cannot be used independently (single-entity), the shortest expiry applies (24 months), and the interaction after combination must also be considered.

blocks.zh: IV.B.5 — 21 CFR 211.165: Testing and Release for Distribution / 測試與放行
blocks.en: IV.B.5 - 21 CFR 211.165: Testing and Release for Distribution

blocks.zh: 解說：211.165 — 「放行測試」的藥品邏輯
blocks.en: Commentary: 211.165 - the drug logic of "release testing"

blocks.zh: 211.165 要求的放行測試核心
blocks.en: Core release testing required by 211.165

blocks.zh: 鑑別（Identity）：確認活性成分是正確的
blocks.en: Identity: confirm that the active ingredient is the correct one

blocks.zh: 強度（Strength）：確認活性成分含量符合規格
blocks.en: Strength: confirm that the active ingredient content meets specification

blocks.zh: 純度（Purity）：確認雜質在可接受範圍
blocks.en: Purity: confirm that impurities are within the acceptable range

blocks.zh: 品質（Quality）：其他理化及微生物特性
blocks.en: Quality: other physicochemical and microbiological characteristics

blocks.zh: 每批都必須測試：不能跳批
blocks.en: Every batch must be tested: batches cannot be skipped

blocks.zh: 書面程序：取樣計畫與測試方法必須有SOP
blocks.en: Written procedures: the sampling plan and test methods must be covered by SOPs

blocks.zh: 器材廠的最大落差：功能測試 vs. 藥品放行測試
blocks.en: The biggest gap at device manufacturers: functional testing vs. drug release testing

blocks.zh: 器材廠通常有完善的功能性放行測試（爆裂壓力、拉伸強度、密封完整性等）。但藥品放行測試完全不同——重點是活性成分的化學分析。
blocks.en: Device manufacturers usually have well-established functional release tests (burst pressure, tensile strength, seal integrity, and so on). Drug release testing is entirely different: the focus is chemical analysis of the active ingredient.

blocks.zh: 對以820為主體的廠商而言，211.165是最需要新建能力的一項要求，因為它通常需要：分析化學儀器（HPLC等）、有資格的化學分析人員、已驗證的分析方法。
blocks.en: For manufacturers with 820 as the main framework, 211.165 is the requirement that most often demands new capability, because it usually needs analytical chemistry instruments (HPLC and so on), qualified analytical chemists, and validated analytical methods.

blocks.zh: CDMO實務：代理測試樣品的可接受性
blocks.en: CDMO practice: acceptability of surrogate test samples

blocks.zh: FDA明確允許，在某些情況下，可以使用「非完整組合產品」的代表性樣品進行藥品放行測試，前提是：
blocks.en: FDA expressly allows, in some cases, representative samples of a "non-complete combination product" to be used for drug release testing, provided that:

blocks.zh: 必須有橋接研究（Bridging Studies）證明代理樣品與最終產品在測試屬性上等效
blocks.en: Bridging studies demonstrate that the surrogate sample is equivalent to the final product for the tested attributes

blocks.zh: 製造過程的差異不影響藥品組成部分
blocks.en: Differences in the manufacturing process do not affect the drug constituent part

blocks.zh: 需獲得主責中心（Lead Center）和OCP的認可
blocks.en: The lead center and OCP agree to the approach

blocks.zh: 例如：預填充注射器廠商可能以充填相同藥液的測試瓶進行放行測試，前提是有數據支持等效性。
blocks.en: For example, a prefilled syringe manufacturer might use test vials filled with the same drug solution for release testing, provided data support equivalence.

blocks.zh: IV.B.6 — 21 CFR 211.166: Stability Testing / 穩定性測試
blocks.en: IV.B.6 - 21 CFR 211.166: Stability Testing

blocks.zh: 解說：211.166 — 穩定性是組合產品的核心科學
blocks.en: Commentary: 211.166 - stability is the core science of combination products

blocks.zh: 211.166 穩定性計畫的必要元素
blocks.en: Required elements of a 211.166 stability program

blocks.zh: 書面穩定性計畫：每個產品都必須有
blocks.en: Written stability program: required for every product

blocks.zh: 樣本數量：足以在各測試時間點進行完整測試
blocks.en: Number of samples: sufficient to perform complete testing at each test time point

blocks.zh: 儲存條件：與標籤聲稱的條件一致
blocks.en: Storage conditions: consistent with the conditions claimed on the label

blocks.zh: 測試頻率：各時間點（如0、3、6、12、24個月）
blocks.en: Testing frequency: at each time point (for example 0, 3, 6, 12, 24 months)

blocks.zh: 進行中穩定性（On-going Stability）：持續監測上市批次
blocks.en: On-going stability: continued monitoring of marketed batches

blocks.zh: 最終容器測試：單一實體組合產品必須在最終組合狀態下測試
blocks.en: Final container testing: single-entity combination products must be tested in the final combined state

blocks.zh: 器材變更 = 穩定性重新評估
blocks.en: Device change = stability reassessment

blocks.zh: 這是最常被忽視的要求之一。器材組成部分的任何變更（材質、尺寸、形狀、製造工藝）都可能影響藥品穩定性，需要重新評估是否需要新的穩定性研究。例如：
blocks.en: This is one of the most frequently overlooked requirements. Any change to the device constituent part (material, dimensions, shape, manufacturing process) may affect drug stability, and you must reassess whether a new stability study is needed. For example:

blocks.zh: 藥物塗層球囊改變球囊直徑 → 塗層面積/厚度改變 → 藥品穩定性可能受影響
blocks.en: Drug-coated balloon changes balloon diameter: coating area/thickness changes, so drug stability may be affected

blocks.zh: DES的聚合物材料更換 → 藥物釋放動力學改變 → 需新穩定性數據
blocks.en: DES polymer material replaced: drug release kinetics change, so new stability data are needed

blocks.zh: 預填充注射器橡膠塞供應商更換 → 相容性/提取物改變 → 需評估穩定性影響
blocks.en: Prefilled syringe rubber stopper supplier changed: compatibility/extractables change, so the impact on stability must be assessed

blocks.zh: CDMO實務：穩定性研究策略
blocks.en: CDMO practice: stability study strategy

blocks.zh: 括弧法（Bracketing）：如果產品家族中最小和最大規格的穩定性可以代表中間規格，可以只測試端點規格，不需全部規格都做完整穩定性研究。
blocks.en: Bracketing: if the stability of the smallest and largest strengths in a product family can represent the intermediate strengths, only the extremes need testing, and full stability studies are not needed for every strength.

blocks.zh: 矩陣法（Matrixing）：減少測試時間點的策略設計，在維持統計力的前提下降低測試負擔。
blocks.en: Matrixing: a strategic design that reduces the number of test time points, lowering the testing burden while maintaining statistical power.

blocks.zh: 借用已上市產品數據：新產品若是已上市組合產品的微小改動（如改變導管長度，但藥品塗層不變），可能可以借用現有穩定性數據，加速開發時程。
blocks.en: Borrowing data from marketed products: if a new product is a minor modification of a marketed combination product (for example, a different catheter length with the same drug coating), existing stability data may be leveraged, speeding up the development timeline.

blocks.zh: 比喻：藥品穩定性是組合產品的「限速步驟」
blocks.en: Analogy: drug stability is the "rate-limiting step" of a combination product

blocks.zh: 就像汽車的發動機（藥品）和車身（器材）——就算車身設計可以用50年，發動機的使用壽命才決定整台車多久需要「過期」。器材組成部分的壽命通常遠超藥品組成部分的穩定性，因此藥品穩定性往往是組合產品效期的決定因素。
blocks.en: Think of a car with an engine (the drug) and a body (the device). Even if the body is designed to last 50 years, it is the engine's service life that determines when the whole car "expires". The life of the device constituent part is usually far longer than the stability of the drug constituent part, so drug stability is often what determines the expiry of the combination product.

blocks.zh: 是否需要新穩定性研究：決策流程
blocks.en: Is a new stability study needed? Decision flow

blocks.zh: 情境1：全新組合產品 → 必須進行完整穩定性研究
blocks.en: Scenario 1: brand-new combination product → a full stability study is required

blocks.zh: 情境2：現有產品的輕微改動（低風險） → 可能可採用縮短的穩定性研究，或借用矩陣法，需聯繫Lead Center
blocks.en: Scenario 2: minor change to an existing product (low risk) → a reduced stability study or matrixing may be possible; contact the lead center

blocks.zh: 情境3：Co-packaged，藥品已有標示效期 → 若組合步驟不影響藥品，可能可依賴現有效期，但需文件化證明
blocks.en: Scenario 3: co-packaged, drug already has a labeled expiry → if the combining step does not affect the drug, the existing expiry may be relied on, but this must be justified with documentation

blocks.zh: 情境4：任何可能影響藥品的變更 → 必須重新評估，可能需要新研究
blocks.en: Scenario 4: any change that may affect the drug → must be reassessed; a new study may be needed

blocks.zh: IV.B.7 — 21 CFR 211.167: Special Testing Requirements / 特殊測試要求
blocks.en: IV.B.7 - 21 CFR 211.167: Special Testing Requirements

blocks.zh: 解說：211.167 — 無菌組合產品的關鍵測試
blocks.en: Commentary: 211.167 - key testing for sterile combination products

blocks.zh: 無菌組合產品：雙重測試要求
blocks.en: Sterile combination products: dual testing requirement

blocks.zh: 對於單一實體無菌組合產品（如預填充注射器）：
blocks.en: For single-entity sterile combination products (such as prefilled syringes):

blocks.zh: 藥品組成部分（藥液）必須通過無菌/熱原測試
blocks.en: The drug constituent part (the drug solution) must pass sterility/pyrogen testing

blocks.zh: 最終組合產品整體也必須通過無菌/熱原測試
blocks.en: The final combination product as a whole must also pass sterility/pyrogen testing

blocks.zh: 對於共同包裝產品（如裝滿藥液的小瓶 + 空注射器）：只需測試含藥液的小瓶，空注射器的無菌性由其他法規要求管控（設計控制、製程控制）。
blocks.en: For co-packaged products (such as a vial filled with drug solution + an empty syringe): only the drug-containing vial needs to be tested. The sterility of the empty syringe is controlled by other regulatory requirements (design controls, process controls).

blocks.zh: 內毒素測試的批次定義彈性
blocks.en: Flexibility in batch definition for endotoxin testing

blocks.zh: FDA在此提供了重要的操作靈活性：對於熱原/內毒素測試，可以將「批次」定義為含藥液的中間組件（而非最終組合產品），前提是：
blocks.en: FDA offers important operational flexibility here: for pyrogen/endotoxin testing, the "batch" may be defined as the drug-containing intermediate component (rather than the final combination product), provided that:

blocks.zh: 有充分的上游控制措施減少熱原
blocks.en: There are adequate upstream control measures to reduce pyrogens

blocks.zh: 已評估器材材質引起熱原的風險
blocks.en: The pyrogen risk arising from device materials has been assessed

blocks.zh: 在「批次定義點」之後的製造步驟不會引入新的熱原風險
blocks.en: Manufacturing steps after the "batch definition point" do not introduce new pyrogen risk

blocks.zh: 這在實務上非常重要：測試整個組合產品（如DES）可能技術上很困難，允許在更早的製造步驟定義批次進行測試，大大簡化了操作。
blocks.en: This matters a great deal in practice: testing the whole combination product (such as a DES) may be technically difficult, and allowing the batch to be defined at an earlier manufacturing step for testing greatly simplifies operations.

blocks.zh: CDMO實務：藥物洗脫支架的溶出試驗
blocks.en: CDMO practice: dissolution testing of drug-eluting stents

blocks.zh: 依維莫司洗脫支架（Everolimus-Eluting Stent）必須符合211.167(c)——每批都需進行藥物釋放速率測試（In Vitro Drug Release / IVDR），確認藥物依照設計的動力學釋放。
blocks.en: An everolimus-eluting stent must comply with 211.167(c): every batch requires in vitro drug release (IVDR) testing to confirm that the drug is released with the designed kinetics.

blocks.zh: 這比一般藥品的溶出試驗更複雜，因為：支架幾何形狀影響釋放；需要模擬生理條件的測試介質；測試本身可能是破壞性的（無法保留支架繼續使用）。這些都需要納入放行測試計畫中。
blocks.en: This is more complex than dissolution testing for a typical drug product because stent geometry affects release, a test medium simulating physiological conditions is needed, and the test itself may be destructive (the stent cannot be kept for use). All of this must be built into the release testing plan.

blocks.zh: 比喻：參數放行的保險邏輯
blocks.en: Analogy: the insurance logic of parametric release

blocks.zh:
傳統滅菌放行：每批都做無菌測試（費時2週）→ 才放行。
參數放行：滅菌製程經過完整驗證，每批監控所有製程參數（溫度、時間、F₀值），若參數全部合格，可省略無菌測試直接放行。
blocks.en:
Traditional sterilization release: a sterility test is done on every batch (taking 2 weeks) before release.
Parametric release: the sterilization process is fully validated and all process parameters (temperature, time, F₀ value) are monitored for every batch. If all parameters pass, the sterility test can be omitted and the batch released directly.

blocks.zh: 組合產品同樣可申請參數放行，但需要事前與FDA溝通，並納入上市前申請。
blocks.en: Combination products can likewise apply for parametric release, but this requires prior discussion with FDA and inclusion in the premarket application.

blocks.zh: 一家CDMO生產以下產品，請判斷各適用哪個211.167子條款：
blocks.en: A CDMO manufactures the following products. Decide which 211.167 paragraph applies to each:

blocks.zh: 預填充胰島素注射器（PFS）
blocks.en: Prefilled insulin syringe (PFS)

blocks.zh: 藥物洗脫腦部植入物（含緩釋化療藥）
blocks.en: Drug-eluting brain implant (with a sustained-release chemotherapy drug)

blocks.zh: OTC眼用抗生素軟膏 + 眼罩（co-packaged）
blocks.en: OTC ophthalmic antibiotic ointment + eye patch (co-packaged)

blocks.zh: 乾粉吸入器（含抗生素粉末）
blocks.en: Dry powder inhaler (containing antibiotic powder)

blocks.zh: 答案：1→(a)；2→(a)+(c)（無菌且控釋）；3→(a)+(b)；4→(a)（注意：DPI若非聲稱無菌則(a)可能不適用）。
blocks.en: Answer: 1 → (a); 2 → (a) + (c) (sterile and controlled-release); 3 → (a) + (b); 4 → (a) (note: if the DPI is not claimed to be sterile, (a) may not apply).

blocks.zh: IV.B.8 — 21 CFR 211.170: Reserve Samples / 留樣
blocks.en: IV.B.8 - 21 CFR 211.170: Reserve Samples

blocks.zh: 解說：211.170 — 器材廠沒有等效要求的全新義務
blocks.en: Commentary: 211.170 - a new obligation with no device equivalent

blocks.zh: 器材QS沒有留樣要求
blocks.en: Device QS has no reserve sample requirement

blocks.zh: 21 CFR Part 820中完全沒有等同於211.170的留樣規定。器材製造商通常保留設計驗證樣品、工程樣品，但沒有「每批保留2倍測試量、在效期後再保留1年」的法規義務。
blocks.en: 21 CFR Part 820 has no provision equivalent to 211.170 for reserve samples. Device manufacturers usually retain design verification samples and engineering samples, but there is no regulatory obligation to "retain twice the quantity needed for testing, for one year after expiry".

blocks.zh: 這是器材廠導入藥品組成部分後最需要建立的新體系之一。
blocks.en: This is one of the new systems a device manufacturer most needs to establish after introducing a drug constituent part.

blocks.zh: Single-Entity vs. Co-packaged：留樣範圍不同
blocks.en: Single-entity vs. co-packaged: different reserve sample scope

blocks.zh: Co-packaged（如小瓶 + 注射器）：只需保留藥品組成部分（小瓶），不需保留器材組成部分（注射器），但需有注射器可用以進行留樣測試時的使用。
blocks.en: Co-packaged (such as vial + syringe): only the drug constituent part (the vial) must be retained, not the device constituent part (the syringe), but a syringe must be available for use when the reserve sample is tested.

blocks.zh: Single-entity（如預填充注射器、DES）：必須保留整個組合產品，因為器材（注射器筒體/支架）就是藥品的容器/載體，無法分離留樣。
blocks.en: Single-entity (such as prefilled syringe, DES): the whole combination product must be retained, because the device (syringe barrel/stent) is the container/carrier of the drug and cannot be separated for retention.

blocks.zh: CDMO實務：留樣管理的實際考量
blocks.en: CDMO practice: practical considerations in reserve sample management

blocks.zh: 儲存空間：預填充注射器批量數萬支，2倍測試量仍是相當大的冷藏空間需求，且需維持到效期後1年（共可能3-4年以上）。
blocks.en: Storage space: prefilled syringe batches run to tens of thousands of units, so twice the testing quantity is still a substantial cold storage requirement, and it must be kept until 1 year after expiry (potentially 3-4 years or more in total).

blocks.zh: 異地儲存：FDA允許留樣存放在非製造廠的地點（如合約倉庫、供應商設施），但必須有書面協議確保：適當儲存條件、製造商可隨時取用、有足夠測試能力、批次數量充足。
blocks.en: Off-site storage: FDA allows reserve samples to be stored at a location other than the manufacturing site (such as a contract warehouse or supplier facility), but a written agreement must ensure appropriate storage conditions, access by the manufacturer at any time, adequate testing capability, and sufficient batch quantity.

blocks.zh: 定期目視檢查：藥品留樣必須至少每年目視檢查一次，評估外觀劣化跡象，並記錄結果。
blocks.en: Periodic visual inspection: drug reserve samples must be visually inspected at least once a year for signs of deterioration, and the results recorded.

blocks.zh: 比喻：留樣是產品上市後的「證人」
blocks.en: Analogy: reserve samples are the product's "witness" after release

blocks.zh: 想像每批產品出貨後，保留部分樣品在倉庫「作證」——如果未來發生投訴（如藥效不足、不良反應），可以取出留樣重新測試，確認問題是產品本身的問題還是儲存/運輸問題，或確認問題不存在（防止不合理投訴）。
blocks.en: Imagine that after each batch ships, some samples are kept in the warehouse to "testify". If a complaint arises later (such as insufficient efficacy or an adverse reaction), the reserve samples can be retested to determine whether the problem lies in the product itself or in storage/transport, or to confirm that no problem exists (preventing unjustified complaints).

blocks.zh: 沒有留樣，就沒有辦法進行這種事後調查。這就是為什麼FDA要求保留到效期後再加1年——確保整個產品生命週期內都有可調查的樣品。
blocks.en: Without reserve samples, this kind of retrospective investigation is impossible. That is why FDA requires retention until 1 year past expiry, ensuring samples are available for investigation throughout the product lifecycle.

blocks.zh: 一批DES（藥物洗脫支架，效期18個月）的留樣計畫應包含什麼？保留到什麼時候？可以只留支架上的藥品部分嗎？
blocks.en: What should the reserve sample plan for a batch of DES (drug-eluting stents, expiry 18 months) include? Until when must the samples be retained? Can only the drug portion on the stent be retained?

blocks.zh: 答案：必須保留完整支架（single-entity），數量為所有必要測試（如IVDR、無菌測試）所需量的2倍（無菌/熱原測試除外）。保留期限：18個月效期 + 1年 = 效期後1年（即30個月後才可處置）。不可只留藥品部分，因為支架是藥品的容器/載體。
blocks.en: Answer: The complete stent must be retained (single-entity), in a quantity twice that needed for all required testing (such as IVDR and sterility testing), excluding sterility/pyrogen testing. Retention period: 18-month expiry + 1 year = 1 year after expiry (disposal is allowed only after month 30). Retaining only the drug portion is not acceptable, because the stent is the container/carrier of the drug.

blocks.zh: Summary: The 8 Drug CGMP Provisions Under Device QS Streamlined Approach / 器材QS途徑的8項藥品CGMP附加要求總覽
blocks.en: Summary: The 8 Drug CGMP Provisions Under Device QS Streamlined Approach

blocks.zh: 解說：8項要求的優先順序與CDMO影響度
blocks.en: Commentary: priority of the 8 requirements and impact on CDMOs

blocks.zh: CDMO策略建議
blocks.en: CDMO strategy recommendations

blocks.zh: 對於評估承接藥械組合產品業務的CDMO，優先評估以下Gap項目：
blocks.en: For a CDMO evaluating whether to take on drug-device combination product business, assess the following gap items first:
Analytical chemistry capability (supports 211.84, 211.165, 211.167)
Stability facilities and program (supports 211.166, 211.137)

blocks.zh: 留樣儲存空間（支持211.170）
blocks.en: Reserve sample storage space (supports 211.170)

blocks.zh: 產量計算SOP（支持211.103）
blocks.en: Yield calculation SOP (supports 211.103)

blocks.zh: OTC適用性評估（211.132）通常最後考慮，因為大多數無菌組合產品是處方產品。
blocks.en: OTC applicability assessment (211.132) is usually considered last, because most sterile combination products are prescription products.

blocks.zh: IV.C — Combination Products Including Biological Products and HCT/Ps / 含生物製劑與HCT/P的組合產品
blocks.en: IV.C - Combination Products Including Biological Products and HCT/Ps

blocks.zh: 解說：生物製劑與HCT/P組合產品的額外義務
blocks.en: Commentary: additional obligations for biological product and HCT/P combination products

blocks.zh: 關鍵原則：「疊加」而非「替代」
blocks.en: Key principle: "layering", not "substitution"

blocks.zh: 21 CFR Part 4的簡化途徑（無論是藥品CGMP基礎或器材QS基礎）不能取代生物製劑CGMP（21 CFR 600-680）或HCT/P的CGTP（21 CFR 1271）。
blocks.en: The 21 CFR Part 4 streamlined approaches (whether drug CGMP-based or device QS-based) do not replace biological product CGMP (21 CFR 600-680) or the CGTP for HCT/Ps (21 CFR 1271).

blocks.zh: 包含生物製劑的組合產品 = Part 4簡化途徑 + 21 CFR 600-680
blocks.en: Combination product containing a biological product = Part 4 streamlined approach + 21 CFR 600-680

blocks.zh: 包含HCT/P的組合產品 = Part 4簡化途徑 + 21 CFR 1271（+可能的600-680）
blocks.en: Combination product containing an HCT/P = Part 4 streamlined approach + 21 CFR 1271 (+ possibly 600-680)

blocks.zh: 什麼是「生物製劑」？（21 CFR Part 600-680）
blocks.en: What is a "biological product"? (21 CFR Parts 600-680)

blocks.zh: 依據PHS Act Section 351，生物製劑包括：
blocks.en: Under Section 351 of the PHS Act, biological products include:

blocks.zh: 血液及血液成分製品（Part 606）
blocks.en: Blood and blood component products (Part 606)

blocks.zh: 疫苗（Part 610+特定要求）
blocks.en: Vaccines (Part 610 + specific requirements)

blocks.zh: 治療用蛋白質（如單株抗體、酵素替代療法）
blocks.en: Therapeutic proteins (such as monoclonal antibodies and enzyme replacement therapies)

blocks.zh: 細胞與基因治療產品
blocks.en: Cell and gene therapy products

blocks.zh: 過敏原製品
blocks.en: Allergenic products

blocks.zh: 每類生物製劑都有其特定的Part 600-680要求，並非所有條款適用於所有生物製劑。
blocks.en: Each category of biological product has its own specific Part 600-680 requirements, and not all provisions apply to all biological products.

blocks.zh: 什麼是HCT/P？（21 CFR Part 1271）
blocks.en: What is an HCT/P? (21 CFR Part 1271)

blocks.zh: HCT/P = Human Cells, Tissues, and Cellular and Tissue-Based Products（人類細胞、組織及細胞/組織基產品）
blocks.en: HCT/P = Human Cells, Tissues, and Cellular and Tissue-Based Products

blocks.zh: 僅受Section 361管控的HCT/P（最低限度操作、同質性使用等）：只需遵守Part 1271。
blocks.en: HCT/Ps regulated solely under Section 361 (minimally manipulated, homologous use, and so on): only need to comply with Part 1271.

blocks.zh: 也被監管為藥品/器材/生物製劑的HCT/P：需同時遵守Part 1271（CGTP）+ Part 4的適用途徑 + 可能的600-680。
blocks.en: HCT/Ps also regulated as drugs/devices/biological products: must comply with Part 1271 (CGTP) + the applicable Part 4 approach + possibly 600-680.

blocks.zh: CDMO實務：生物製劑組合產品的典型例子
blocks.en: CDMO practice: typical examples of biological product combination products

blocks.zh: 預填充單抗注射器（如貝伐珠單抗PFS）：Part 4 + Part 211 + Part 600-680（生物製劑CGMP）
blocks.en: Prefilled monoclonal antibody syringe (such as bevacizumab PFS): Part 4 + Part 211 + Part 600-680 (biologics CGMP)

blocks.zh: CAR-T細胞療法 + 輸液器材：Part 4 + Part 211（或820）+ Part 600-680 + Part 1271
blocks.en: CAR-T cell therapy + infusion device: Part 4 + Part 211 (or 820) + Part 600-680 + Part 1271

blocks.zh: 同種異體骨移植 + 固定器材：Part 4 + Part 820 + Part 1271（如為Section 351產品）
blocks.en: Allogeneic bone graft + fixation device: Part 4 + Part 820 + Part 1271 (if a Section 351 product)

blocks.zh: 血小板濃縮液 + 傷口護理器材：Part 4 + Part 606 + Part 1271
blocks.en: Platelet concentrate + wound care device: Part 4 + Part 606 + Part 1271

blocks.zh: 生物製劑為何需要額外CGMP？
blocks.en: Why do biological products need additional CGMP?

blocks.zh: FDA明確指出，對於生物製劑，製程一致性（Consistency of Manufacturing）本身就是保障安全性、純度和效力的核心手段。生物製劑的複雜性意味著：
blocks.en: FDA states explicitly that for biological products, consistency of manufacturing is itself a core means of assuring safety, purity, and potency. The complexity of biological products means that:

blocks.zh: 終產品測試無法完全表徵產品品質（批次間差異難以由最終測試捕捉）
blocks.en: Finished product testing cannot fully characterize product quality (batch-to-batch variation is hard to capture in final testing)

blocks.zh: 必須確保每批製造過程高度一致，才能保障患者安全
blocks.en: The manufacturing process must be highly consistent from batch to batch to protect patient safety

blocks.zh: Part 600-680涵蓋了這些生物製劑特有的挑戰（如病毒清除、效力測試、批次放行特殊要求）
blocks.en: Parts 600-680 address these biologics-specific challenges (such as viral clearance, potency testing, and special lot release requirements)

blocks.zh: CGTP（組織規範）與CGMP的交互關係
blocks.en: Interaction between CGTP (tissue practices) and CGMP

blocks.zh: Part 1271（CGTP）與Part 210/211或Part 820（CGMP）之間：
blocks.en: Between Part 1271 (CGTP) and Part 210/211 or Part 820 (CGMP):

blocks.zh: 互補而非取代：兩者共同存在，各有其適用範疇
blocks.en: Complementary, not substitutive: both apply together, each within its own scope

blocks.zh: 特殊規定優先：若有衝突，針對特定產品更具體的法規優先適用
blocks.en: Specific provisions prevail: if there is a conflict, the regulation that is more specific to the product applies

blocks.zh: 捐贈者資格（Donor Eligibility）：這是CGTP獨有的要求，CGMP中沒有等效規定，目的是防止傳染性疾病傳播
blocks.en: Donor eligibility: a requirement unique to CGTP with no equivalent in CGMP, intended to prevent the transmission of communicable diseases

blocks.zh: 比喻：法規層次像「洋蔥」
blocks.en: Analogy: regulatory layers are like an "onion"

blocks.zh: 生物製劑組合產品的法規要求像一個多層洋蔥：
blocks.en: The regulatory requirements for a biological product combination product are like a multi-layered onion:

blocks.zh: 最外層：Part 4（組合產品框架）
blocks.en: Outermost layer: Part 4 (combination product framework)

blocks.zh: 中間層：Part 211 或 Part 820（藥品CGMP或器材QS）
blocks.en: Middle layer: Part 211 or Part 820 (drug CGMP or device QS)

blocks.zh: 內層：Part 600-680（生物製劑CGMP）
blocks.en: Inner layer: Parts 600-680 (biologics CGMP)

blocks.zh: 最核心（若有HCT/P）：Part 1271（CGTP）
blocks.en: Innermost core (if an HCT/P is involved): Part 1271 (CGTP)

blocks.zh: 每一層都不能省略，且往往相互疊加。複雜程度遠高於單純的藥品或器材。
blocks.en: No layer can be omitted, and they often stack on one another. The complexity is far greater than for a plain drug or device.

blocks.zh: 一個CAR-T細胞療法（基因改造T細胞）被裝入一次性輸注器材中作為組合產品，以器材QS簡化途徑運作。請列出所有必須遵守的主要法規框架。
blocks.en: A CAR-T cell therapy (genetically modified T cells) is loaded into a single-use infusion device as a combination product and operates under the device QS streamlined approach. List all the major regulatory frameworks that must be followed.

blocks.zh: 答案：(1) 21 CFR Part 820（器材QS，主體）+ (2) 21 CFR 4.4(b)(2)附加的8項藥品CGMP規定 + (3) 21 CFR 600-680（生物製劑CGMP，因為CAR-T是生物製劑）+ (4) 21 CFR 1271（CGTP，因為CAR-T是HCT/P，且非僅受Section 361管控）。這是最複雜的組合產品法規場景之一。
blocks.en: Answer: (1) 21 CFR Part 820 (device QS, the main framework) + (2) the 8 drug CGMP provisions added under 21 CFR 4.4(b)(2) + (3) 21 CFR 600-680 (biologics CGMP, because CAR-T is a biological product) + (4) 21 CFR 1271 (CGTP, because CAR-T is an HCT/P and is not regulated solely under Section 361). This is one of the most complex regulatory scenarios for a combination product.

blocks.zh: Section Summary / 本節總結
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 重點摘要
blocks.en: Key takeaways

blocks.zh: IV.B 核心記憶點
blocks.en: IV.B key points to remember

blocks.zh: 8項要求是器材QS途徑的「附加套餐」，不是可選的
blocks.en: The 8 requirements are the "add-on package" of the device QS approach and are not optional

blocks.zh: 僅211.132（防篡改）有條件限制（OTC才適用）
blocks.en: Only 211.132 (tamper-evident packaging) has a conditional limitation (OTC only)
The biggest gaps for device manufacturers: 211.84 (identity testing), 211.165 (drug release), 211.166 (stability), 211.170 (reserve samples)

blocks.zh: 產量計算（211.103）是器材廠完全陌生的概念，需建立新的文件體系
blocks.en: Yield calculation (211.103) is a concept entirely unfamiliar to device manufacturers and requires a new documentation system

blocks.zh: 效期必須基於穩定性數據，器材組成部分的任何變更都可能觸發穩定性重新評估
blocks.en: Expiry must be based on stability data, and any change to the device constituent part may trigger a stability reassessment

blocks.zh: IV.C 核心記憶點
blocks.en: IV.C key points to remember

blocks.zh: Part 4簡化途徑不取代21 CFR 600-680或21 CFR 1271
blocks.en: The Part 4 streamlined approach does not replace 21 CFR 600-680 or 21 CFR 1271

blocks.zh: 含生物製劑 = 必加600-680（疊加）
blocks.en: Contains a biological product = 600-680 must be added (layering)

blocks.zh: 含HCT/P（非僅361管控）= 必加1271（疊加）
blocks.en: Contains an HCT/P (not solely Section 361) = 1271 must be added (layering)

blocks.zh: CGTP和CGMP互補，特殊規定優先於一般規定
blocks.en: CGTP and CGMP are complementary, and specific provisions prevail over general ones

blocks.zh: 具體要求因生物製劑類型而異，複雜情況應聯繫Lead Center或OCP
blocks.en: Specific requirements vary by type of biological product; contact the lead center or OCP for complex cases

blocks.zh: CDMO業務評估檢查清單
blocks.en: CDMO business evaluation checklist

blocks.zh: 在評估是否承接藥械組合產品業務前，確認以下能力：
blocks.en: Before deciding whether to take on drug-device combination product business, confirm the following capabilities:

blocks.zh: [ ] 分析化學測試能力（HPLC、身份鑑別）
blocks.en: [ ] Analytical chemistry testing capability (HPLC, identity testing)

blocks.zh: [ ] 穩定性設施與ICH穩定性計畫
blocks.en: [ ] Stability facilities and an ICH stability program

blocks.zh: [ ] 留樣儲存空間（含溫控）
blocks.en: [ ] Reserve sample storage space (temperature-controlled)

blocks.zh: [ ] 產量計算SOP與雙人複核流程
blocks.en: [ ] Yield calculation SOP and second-person verification process

blocks.zh: [ ] 特殊測試能力（滅菌驗證、內毒素、溶出）
blocks.en: [ ] Special testing capability (sterilization validation, endotoxin, dissolution)

blocks.zh: [ ] 若含生物製劑：Part 600-680合規評估
blocks.en: [ ] If a biological product is involved: Part 600-680 compliance assessment

blocks.zh: [ ] 若含HCT/P：Part 1271 CGTP合規評估
blocks.en: [ ] If an HCT/P is involved: Part 1271 CGTP compliance assessment

blocks.zh: [ ] 已確認產品OTC vs. Rx狀態（影響211.132）
blocks.en: [ ] OTC vs. Rx status of the product confirmed (affects 211.132)
